about: Who can do what in a group: read by web/js/state/permissions.js and server/app/spaces/permissions.py. Each permission names the lowest role allowed; a group can change that (its own `permissions`), and higher roles can always do what lower ones can. Test cases both check: permission-cases.json.

roles.description: Can do everything, including deleting the group
